searchText: This is an old run I believe 🤔. The manual run after updates is still running. I've tried to implement this in Geth, but it makes the parallel-execution+stateroot codepath so convoluted that I don't think it's worth it unless it can somehow be done cleanly :/ the reason it makes it convoluted is because we have to continue tx execution and state root computation even after we hit a mismatch that would render the block invalid. it's not entirely infeasible. I think it just makes the code harder to reason about, and it's already pretty nontrivial [bal v1.6.0](https://github.com/ethereum
